title: On the Reachability Problem in Quantum Petri Nets
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel quantum solution to address the problem of reachability in bounded quantum Petri nets (QPNs), an advanced modeling framework that combines the classical Petri net model with quantum mechanical principles. The proposed approach exploits quantum parallelism to construct a superposition over all reachable markings from the initial marking.
